brief:
Israeli authorities are arresting teachers, closing Palestinian bookshops, demolishing homes, and allowing violent settlers to operate with impunity in East Jerusalem, according to Middle East Eye. The systematic measures target Palestinian institutions and civilians across the occupied territory, constraining educational and cultural life.

Teachers face arrest, businesses have been shuttered, and residential structures demolished as settlers conduct raids without apparent restraint or intervention from occupation forces.

title: Israeli actions erasing Palestinian presence in East Jerusalem
